description: `ThreecxProviderConfig` gains `pbx: { baseUrl, clientId, clientSecretRef, status, lastCheckedAt, lastError, capabilities: { xapi, callControl } }` with `parseThreecxConfig` defaulting `status` to `not_configured`

`saveThreecxPbxCredentials(tenant, { baseUrl, clientId, clientSecret? })` validates `https://` (or `http://` when `THREECX_EMULATOR_MODE=true`), stores the secret through `getSecretProviderInstance().setTenantSecret` under `threecx-pbx-client-secret` and writes only `clientSecretRef` into config
`clearThreecxPbxCredentials(tenant)` removes `config.pbx`, deletes the tenant secret and resets capabilities

`ThreecxPbxClient` in `ee/packages/threecx/src/lib/pbx/client.ts` exposes `xapiGet/xapiPost/xapiPatch/xapiDelete` under `/xapi/v1` and `callControlGet/callControlPost` under `/callcontrol`, each sending `Authorization: Bearer`
`acquireThreecxToken(tenant)` posts `client_id`, `client_secret`, `grant_type=client_credentials` form-encoded to `/connect/token` and returns `{ accessToken, expiresIn }`
Tokens are cached in Redis under `${prefix}threecx:token:<tenant>` with TTL `expires_in - 60`; a cache miss refreshes under a `SET NX` lock so concurrent callers share one token
A 401 from any PBX call evicts the cached token and retries once with a fresh token

`testThreecxPbxConnection(tenant)` acquires a token, probes `GET /xapi/v1/Defs?$select=Id` for `capabilities.xapi` and `GET /callcontrol` for `capabilities.callControl`, and writes `status`, `lastCheckedAt`, `lastError` and capabilities to config
A token failure in `testThreecxPbxConnection` sets `pbx.status = 'error'` with the PBX error text and leaves both capabilities false
Server actions `saveThreecxPbxCredentials`, `testThreecxPbxConnection`, `clearThreecxPbxCredentials` in `telephonyActions.ts` require `canManageTelephony` and go through `requireManageableProvider`
`getThreecxProviderState` returns `pbx` without the secret and with `hasClientSecret: boolean`
`isThreecxEmulatorModeEnabled()` reads `THREECX_EMULATOR_MODE` and is the only place that allows an `http://` PBX base URL
`config.extensions` is `Array<{ dn, pbxDisplayName, pbxEmail, userId, mappedBy }>` plus `extensionsSyncedAt`, parsed tolerantly by `parseThreecxConfig`
`syncThreecxExtensions(tenant)` pages `GET /xapi/v1/Users?$select=Id,Number,FirstName,LastName,EmailAddress,Enabled&$top=200&$skip=N` until a short page and keeps `Enabled` users only
Sync auto-maps each extension to the tenant user whose email equals `EmailAddress` case-insensitively with `mappedBy: 'auto'`
Sync preserves rows with `mappedBy: 'manual'` and drops extensions no longer returned by the PBX
`setThreecxExtensionUser(tenant, { dn, userId })` sets a manual mapping (or clears it with `null`) and refuses an unknown `dn`
`extensionForUser(config, userId)` and `userForExtension(config, dn)` helpers are exported from `@alga-psa/ee-threecx/lib`
Server actions `syncThreecxExtensions` and `setThreecxExtensionUser` in `telephonyActions.ts` require `canManageTelephony`
`threecxCallControlWorkflow` in `ee/temporal-workflows/src/workflows/` runs with workflow id `threecx-callcontrol:<tenant>`, loops the consume activity and `continueAsNew`s after each run
The workflow handles a `stop` signal by returning after the current activity attempt completes
Activity `consumeThreecxCallControl({ tenantId })` opens `wss://<pbx>/callcontrol/ws` with the bearer token, heartbeats every 15 s and returns after one hour
On an `Upsert` event the activity `GET`s the entity path and ignores responses whose `sequence` is older than the latest seen for that participant

A participant entering `Ringing` on a DN present in the extension map forwards `process-threecx-call-event` with `{ kind: 'ringing', dn, participantId, callId, partyCallerId, partyCallerName, partyDid, at }`
A ringing participant entering `Connected` forwards `{ kind: 'connected', dn, participantId, callId }`; a `Remove` for a ringing or connected participant forwards `{ kind: 'ended', ... }`
Participants on DNs absent from the extension map, and status changes that are not the Ringing/Connected/Remove transitions, produce no events
The socket reconnects with backoff 5 s doubling to 120 s; a 401 during the handshake refreshes the token before reconnecting
After 10 minutes of continuous failure the activity writes `pbx.status = 'error'` and `pbx.lastError` and fails so the workflow retries on its own schedule

Maintenance fanout job `reconcile-threecx-call-control` (every 5 min) starts the workflow for tenants with an active `3cx` row, `pbx.status = 'connected'` and `capabilities.callControl`, and signals `stop` for tenants that no longer qualify
`reconcile-threecx-call-control` is listed in `MAINTENANCE_FANOUT_SCHEDULES` and `maintenanceJobFanout` with a `tenants` selector of active `3cx` providers
`process-threecx-call-event` is registered with `forwardJobToServer` in `job-activities.ts` and in `registerAllHandlers.ts` under the EE gate list
Handler `processThreecxCallEvent` in `packages/jobs/src/lib/handlers/` resolves the user with `userForExtension` and drops events for unmapped DNs
For `ringing` the handler normalizes `partyCallerId`, runs `matchCallParty`, and loads the matched contact (name, email, phone) and client name
For a matched contact the payload includes up to 5 open tickets for the contact, else the client, ordered by `updated_at desc` with number, title and status
For a matched contact the payload includes the last 3 interactions (type name, title, date)
The handler publishes `{ type: 'telephony.incoming_call', event, call }` on `${prefix}internal-notifications:<tenant>:<userId>` for `ringing`, `connected` and `ended`
`hocuspocus/NotificationExtension.js` relays `telephony.incoming_call` messages into the room Yjs map `incomingCall` as `{ event, call, receivedAt }`
`useInternalNotifications` observes `incomingCall`, exposes `incomingCall` and `dismissIncomingCall()`, and clears it on `connected`/`ended`
`IncomingCallProvider` in `server/src/components/layout/` is mounted in `MspLayoutClient` beside `MspCallLinkProvider` and renders `IncomingCallCard`
`IncomingCallCard` in `packages/telephony/src/components/` renders caller name or Unknown caller, number, client, ringing extension, email, ticket links and interactions

Card actions: Open contact, Open client, New ticket (quick-add ticket prefilled with client and contact), Dismiss; unknown caller shows Create contact (quick-add contact prefilled with the number) and Dismiss
The card auto-closes after 60 seconds and a newer `ringing` replaces the current card
The card is positioned bottom-right above the toaster, is not modal, and every button carries a kebab-case `id`
`getTelephonyCallLinkState` returns `threecx: { connected, extension }` for the current user from the `3cx` row and the extension map
`CallLinkProvider` and `MspCallLinkProvider` carry `threecx` state and a `placeThreecxCall` callback
`CallLink` renders a "Call via 3CX" action beside the `tel:` link when `threecx.connected` and `threecx.extension` are set, and hides it otherwise
`createTelephonyCallIntent` accepts `{ provider, ticketId, phoneNumber }`; for `3cx` it stores `provider_user_id` as the caller's extension DN and refuses when the user has no mapped extension

`report-call` keeps `organizerUserId` as the Alga user resolved from the agent email; 3CX intents store that same user id as `provider_user_id`, so `resolvePendingCallIntent` binds them without an extension lookup

`placeThreecxCall({ phoneNumber, ticketId?, contactId?, clientId? })` (withAuth, non-portal, `interaction:create`) records the intent when `ticketId` is given and posts `{ dn, destination }` to `/xapi/v1/Users/Pbx.MakeCall`
`placeThreecxCall` returns `{ success: false, message }` with the PBX error text on failure and never places a call from a DN other than the caller's mapped extension
Success shows a toast; failure shows the returned message in a destructive toast
`config.cdr` is `{ enabled, lookbackDays, watermark, lastRunAt, lastRunAdded }` with `lookbackDays` defaulting to 30
`setThreecxCallHistoryImport(tenant, { enabled, lookbackDays })` server action requires `canManageTelephony`

Maintenance fanout job `backfill-threecx-cdr` runs hourly for tenants with `cdr.enabled`, `pbx.status = 'connected'` and `capabilities.xapi`, listed in `MAINTENANCE_FANOUT_SCHEDULES` and the fanout map

`backfillThreecxCdr(tenant)` queries `/xapi/v1/CallHistoryView` with `$filter=SegmentStartTime ge <from>`, `$orderby=SegmentStartTime asc`, `$top=200`, `$skip=N` until a short page; the first run uses `now - lookbackDays`
Segments where neither side is external are skipped

`mapCallHistorySegment` derives `inbound` for an external source, `outbound` for an external destination, `missed` for unanswered inbound, the external number as caller or callee, and `organizerUserId` plus agent email from the internal DN through the extension map
`mapCallHistorySegment` sets `startedAt = SegmentStartTime`, `endedAt = SegmentEndTime`, `durationSeconds` parsed from the `CallTime` ISO duration, and `raw` carrying the segment with `SegmentId`
`threecxProviderCallId(agentEmail, number, callType, startTimeUtc)` truncates the start time to whole seconds and is shared by `report-call` and the backfill
A segment is skipped when a `3cx` record exists with the same `provider_call_id`, or with the same `organizer_user_id`, same E.164 number and `started_at` within 60 seconds
Surviving segments are enqueued as `process-telephony-canonical-call`; the run writes `lastRunAt`, `lastRunAdded` and advances `watermark` to the last `SegmentStartTime` minus 5 minutes
`config.phonebook` is `{ enabled, schedule, lastPushAt, lastImportAt, lastPushCounts, lastImportCounts, lastError }` with `schedule` in `daily | hourly`
`setThreecxPhonebookSync(tenant, { enabled, schedule })`, `runThreecxPhonebookPush(tenant)` and `runThreecxPhonebookImport(tenant)` server actions require `canManageTelephony`

Phonebook mappings are rows in `tenant_external_entity_mappings` with `integration_type = '3cx'`, `alga_entity_type = 'contact'`, `external_entity_id = <3CX Contact Id>`, `external_realm_id = pbx.baseUrl`, `metadata.fingerprint`

`buildPbxContact(contact, phones, clientName)` maps `full_name` to `FirstName`/`LastName`, the client to `CompanyName`, the default number to `PhoneNumber`, remaining numbers to `Business`, `Business2`, `Mobile2`, `Home`, `Other` by canonical type, and sets `Tag = 'AlgaPSA'`
`pushThreecxPhonebook(tenant)` creates entries with `POST /xapi/v1/Contacts` for active contacts with a phone and no mapping, and stores the mapping with the fingerprint
Push `PATCH`es `/xapi/v1/Contacts(<id>)` when the fingerprint changed and skips unchanged contacts
Push `DELETE`s entries whose contact is inactive or gone and removes the mapping; a 404 on PATCH recreates the entry and a 404 on DELETE just drops the mapping
`importThreecxPhonebook(tenant)` pages `GET /xapi/v1/Contacts` with `$top=200` and skips entries that have a mapping row or `Tag = 'AlgaPSA'`
Import matches by `Email` case-insensitively, else by `FirstName + ' ' + LastName` against `full_name` case-insensitively when exactly one active contact matches; otherwise the entry is skipped

Import adds each phone field not already on the contact (compared by normalized digits) with the canonical type implied by the field, never creates contacts, never removes numbers, and records a mapping row for the adopted entry

Event subscriber `threecxPhonebookSubscriber` on `CONTACT_CREATED`, `CONTACT_UPDATED`, `CONTACT_ARCHIVED`, `CONTACT_DELETED` enqueues `sync-threecx-phonebook-contact { tenantId, contactId }` for tenants with sync enabled and the PBX connected
Handler `sync-threecx-phonebook-contact` pushes or deletes the single contact's entry using the same create/update/delete rules
Maintenance fanout job `reconcile-threecx-phonebook` runs hourly; a tenant runs push then import when `schedule = 'hourly'`, or when `daily` and `lastPushAt` is older than 23 hours
Push and import errors are recorded in `phonebook.lastError` without aborting the remaining contacts

Route `POST /api/telephony/3cx/[tenantSlug]/contacts` exists with the CE 501 stub, slug resolution, rate limit, bearer verification and the availability gate, delegating to `handleThreecxCreateContact`
`THREECX_ROUTE_SEGMENTS.contacts` is added to `routeConstants.ts` and used by the route, the template and the emulator
The body `{ firstName, lastName, number, email, company }` is validated; a missing name and number and email together answers 400 `invalid_request`
`resolveClientForCompany(tenant, company)` returns an exact case-insensitive `client_name` match, else a `suggestedClientId` from the best `ILIKE '%company%'` match, else null

With an email, the contact is created via `ContactModel.createContact` in a transaction with the number as default business phone, `CONTACT_CREATED` is published, and the response is the lookup shape with `entityId`/`entityType = 'contact'`
With an email that already exists, the route answers 200 with the existing contact instead of creating one
When no client matched exactly, a `contact-origin` row is written to `tenant_external_entity_mappings` with `metadata = { companyName, suggestedClientId, status: 'unmapped' }`

Without an email, a `contact-pending` row is written with a new uuid and `metadata = { firstName, lastName, number, company, suggestedClientId, status: 'pending' }`, and the response `contactUrl` is the integrations settings URL with `?threecxPending=<uuid>` and `entityType = 'pending'`
`listThreecxContactQueue(tenant)` returns unmapped and pending rows with contact details, company text and the suggested client name
`mapThreecxContactToClient(tenant, { contactId, clientId })` updates `contacts.client_id` when a client is given and removes the queue row in both cases

`completeThreecxPendingContact(tenant, { pendingId, firstName, lastName, email, number, clientId })` creates the contact as the route does and deletes the pending row; `dismissThreecxPendingContact` deletes it without creating
The four queue actions in `telephonyActions.ts` require `canManageTelephony`
Migration adds the `Chat` row to `system_interaction_types` following the Online Meeting migration

Migration creates `telephony_chat_records` with the PRD columns, primary key `[tenant, chat_record_id]`, unique `[tenant, provider, provider_chat_id]`, distributed on `tenant` and without RLS policies
Route `POST /api/telephony/3cx/[tenantSlug]/report-chat` exists with the standard guards and `THREECX_ROUTE_SEGMENTS.reportChat`
The body `{ number, email, name, agentEmail, queueExtension, durationSeconds, startTimeUtc, endTimeUtc, messages, entityId, entityType }` is validated; `messages` and `startTimeUtc` are required

`threecxProviderChatId` is SHA-256 of `agentEmail|number|email|startTimeUtc` with the time truncated to seconds; the route enqueues `process-threecx-chat` and answers 202 `{ accepted: true, providerChatId }`
`ingestChat` in `packages/telephony/src/services/ingestChat.ts` inserts the record idempotently on `(tenant, provider, provider_chat_id)` and returns `duplicate` on a repeat
`ingestChat` resolves the contact by `entityId` when `entityType = 'contact'` and the contact is active, else by email case-insensitively, else by number through `matchCallParty`

With a contact, `ingestChat` creates a `Chat` interaction through `interactionCreateHelper` with title `Chat with <name>`, `notes = messages`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `duration`, agent user by email with the telephony actor fallback, and stores `interaction_id`
Without a contact the record is stored as `unmatched`, or `ambiguous` with candidates, and no interaction is created
`process-threecx-chat` is registered in `registerAllHandlers.ts` under the EE gate and forwarded in `job-activities.ts`
`listTelephonyCalls` (or a sibling `listTelephonyChats`) returns unmatched and ambiguous chats and `TelephonyCallsPanel` lists them with a Chat badge and the same assign picker
`resolveTelephonyChat({ chatRecordId, contactId, clientId })` stamps the match, creates the `Chat` interaction and returns `already_resolved` on a second call
`report-call` accepts optional `transcription`, `summary` and `recordingUrl` strings and stores them in `raw`
`processTelephonyCanonicalCall`, on `ingested` with a non-empty `raw.transcription`, creates a transcript document via `createCallTranscriptDocument` associated to contact, client and interaction
The handler writes a `telephony_call_artifacts` row (`artifact_type = 'transcript'`, `provider_artifact_id = 'report-call'`, `document_id`) and sets `artifact_status = 'ready'`
A non-empty `raw.summary` is appended to the interaction notes under a Summary heading
`sweep-telephony-call-artifacts` dispatches per provider; the `3cx` fetcher runs only for tenants with `capabilities.xapi` and records with `artifact_status = 'pending'`
The `3cx` fetcher queries `/xapi/v1/Recordings` filtered to `StartTime` within two minutes of `started_at` and picks the recording whose external number matches the record

When the recording `IsTranscribed`, the fetcher creates the transcript document and artifact row and appends the summary; a recording without transcription keeps the record pending under the existing backoff
When `RecordingUrl` is set, the fetcher downloads `Pbx.DownloadRecording(recId=<Id>)`, uploads with `StorageService.uploadFile` and writes a `recording` artifact with `file_id`
Records with no recording after the backoff limit settle to `artifact_status = 'none'`
`InteractionDetails` loads `telephony_call_artifacts` for interactions referenced by a call record and renders transcript and recording links plus the summary
`lookup`, `lookup-by-email` and `search` responses include `entityId` and `entityType` (`contact` | `client`)
The template maps `entityId`/`entityType` to the `EntityId`/`EntityType` outputs on the three lookup scenarios
`ReportCall` and `ReportChat` requests send `[EntityId]` and `[EntityType]` as `entityId`/`entityType`; `report-call` validates them as optional strings
`ingestCanonicalCall` accepts `preferredContactId`; when that contact exists and is active it is used as the match, else number matching applies
The `report-call` handler passes `raw.entityId` as `preferredContactId` when `raw.entityType = 'contact'`
`renderThreecxTemplate` adds the `CreateContactRecordFromClient` scenario posting `[FirstName]`, `[LastName]`, `[Number]`, `[Email]`, `[Company]` to the contacts route with the same outputs as lookup
`renderThreecxTemplate` adds the `ReportChat` scenario posting the PRD fields including `[ChatMessages]` to the report-chat route
`ReportCall` posts `[Transcription]`, `[Summary]`, `[RecordingUrl]` as `transcription`, `summary`, `recordingUrl`
`THREECX_TEMPLATE_VERSION` increments and the card shows the out-of-date hint when `config.templateVersion` is lower
`@alga-psa/emulator-threecx` declares `ws` and switches from `wire()` to `serve()`, owning an HTTP server on its port with the existing `GET /` health route and CRM-engine actions intact
Seed `pbx-app { clientId, clientSecret, callControl, xapi }` and `POST /connect/token` answers `{ access_token, expires_in, token_type }` for matching credentials and 401 otherwise
Every route except the token endpoint requires a bearer token issued by the emulator and answers 401 otherwise
`GET /xapi/v1/Defs` answers 200 when the app has `xapi`; `GET /callcontrol` answers 200 when it has `callControl`; each answers 403 when the capability is off
Seed `pbx-user { dn, email, firstName, lastName, enabled }` and `GET /xapi/v1/Users` honours `$select`, `$top`, `$skip`

Seed `pbx-contact` and the Contacts routes: `GET /xapi/v1/Contacts` (paged), `POST /xapi/v1/Contacts` (201 with `Id`), `GET|PATCH|DELETE /xapi/v1/Contacts(<id>)`, `POST /xapi/v1/Contacts/Pbx.DeleteContactsById`
Seed `cdr-segment` and `GET /xapi/v1/CallHistoryView` honours `$filter` on `SegmentStartTime ge`, `$orderby`, `$top`, `$skip`

Seed `recording { ..., transcription, summary, isTranscribed, recordingUrl }` and `GET /xapi/v1/Recordings` honours `$filter` on `StartTime`; `GET /xapi/v1/Recordings/Pbx.DownloadRecording(recId=<n>)` streams bytes
`POST /xapi/v1/Users/Pbx.MakeCall` and `POST /callcontrol/:dn/makecall` record `{ dn, destination }` in the `makecalls` state view and answer a participant result
WebSocket `/callcontrol/ws` requires the bearer header on the handshake and pushes `{ sequence, event: { event_type, entity, attached_data } }`

Action `pbx-ring { dn, callerNumber, callerName }` creates a participant in `Ringing`, pushes an Upsert, and `GET /callcontrol/:dn/participants/:id` returns it with `party_caller_id`, `status`, `callid`
Actions `pbx-answer { participantId }` (status `Connected`, Upsert) and `pbx-hangup { participantId }` (Remove) update the `participants` state view
Actions `crm-create-contact` and `crm-report-chat` post to the contacts and report-chat routes with the bearer key and record the exchanges
State views `pbx-contacts`, `makecalls`, `participants`, `tokens` exist beside `exchanges`
Faults `token-invalid` (token endpoint answers 401 while armed) and `ws-drop` (closes every open socket once) are registered
The emulator README documents the 3CX PBX surfaces, seeds, actions and the `THREECX_EMULATOR_MODE` switch
`ThreecxProviderCard` renders the PBX API section with base URL, client id, write-only secret with Replace, Test connection, status badge and two capability chips
The PBX API section shows help text naming the 3CX edition requirement and the need to list monitored extensions in the API app
The Extensions section renders Sync from PBX, last sync time and the extension table with highlighted unmapped rows and a user picker per row
The Call history import section renders the toggle, lookback days input, last run time and records added
The Phonebook sync section renders the toggle, schedule select, Push now, Import now, and last push/import times with counts
The Contacts created from 3CX section lists unmapped rows with a client picker preselected to the suggestion, Apply and Leave without client
Pending rows show Complete, which opens a dialog with editable name and number, required email and the client picker; saving calls `completeThreecxPendingContact`
Loading the integrations page with `?threecxPending=<uuid>` opens the Complete dialog for that row
The new sections render only when the provider is active; PBX-dependent sections show a hint when `pbx.status !== 'connected'`
Every new interactive element carries a kebab-case `id`
All new card strings live under `integrations.telephony.providers.threecx.*` in all ten `msp/integrations.json` locale files
All incoming-call card and Call via 3CX strings live under `telephony.incomingCall.*` and `telephony.callLink.*` in every locale
Chat badge and resolve strings for the attribution panel live under `integrations.telephony.unmatched.*` in every locale
Every 3CX lookup query on `contact_phone_numbers` runs through `tenantDb`, which scopes it by tenant (verified: `primaryNumberE164` cannot read another tenant's numbers)
The CE build compiles with `@alga-psa/ee-threecx` aliased away and the two new routes answer 501 through `eeUnavailable()`
`telephonyJobWiring.wiring.test.ts` covers the new job names in both the worker forwarders and the server registry
